3: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Isn't David hiding himself among us?" Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
4: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
5: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven't set God before them. Selah.
6: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
7: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
8: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Lord, for it is good.
9: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
